svg.text: VGPR[lane][j] = matrix[(lane/16)×8 + j][lane%16] · lane%16 → column (N), (lane/16)×8+j → row (M)
Applies to all gfx12 WMMA types: FP16, FP32, INT4…
Ln[j] = lane n, accumulator slot j
Each lane owns a full column of 8 elements.
All 32 lanes together cover the full 16×16 tile.
Note: A/B operand layout ≠ D/C accumulator layout on gfx12.
For chained WMMA, write D to shared memory in row-major, then reload as B operand.
